name: attention_sliding_window
reference:
import math
import torch

def run(q, k, v):
    q = q.float()
    repeat = q.shape[1] // k.shape[1]
    k = k.float().repeat_interleave(repeat, dim=1)
    v = v.float().repeat_interleave(repeat, dim=1)
    scores = torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(-1, -2)) / math.sqrt(q.shape[-1])
    scores = scores.masked_fill(torch.arange(scores.shape[-1], device=scores.device)[None, None, None, :] < max(0, scores.shape[-1] - 4), float('-inf'))
    scores = scores
    probs = torch.softmax(scores, dim=-1)
    return torch.matmul(probs, v).to(torch.bfloat16)
